_comment: Reproduced metadata for the four anonymized Amazon Sports rows in the submitted paper's failure-oriented case study. anonymous_item_id is a stable repository identifier, not an original product identifier or ASIN; no unreported identity is invented.

cases.title: Classic Soccer Ball, Size 4, Blue/Yellow
cases.visual_evidence: Bright blue/yellow color; youth-oriented appearance; soft rubber texture; backyard or school-field scene.
cases.text_only_failure: text-only SID may place it near generic training or match balls.
cases.descriptor: parent-purchased youth beginner soccer practice; school/recreational play.

cases.title: Classic Soccer Ball, Size 5, White/Black
cases.visual_evidence: Standard match-ball texture; stitched panels; grass/turf field; full-size goal and club-practice cues.
cases.text_only_failure: surface text remains close to the youth ball, but usage intent differs.
cases.descriptor: competitive outdoor soccer training; adult club practice; match preparation.

cases.title: Soccer Training Ball, Size 4
cases.visual_evidence: Indoor court/gym-floor setting; compact size; futsal-style use; low-bounce or hard-court control cues.
cases.text_only_failure: short title can collapse into ordinary soccer training balls.
cases.descriptor: indoor futsal low-bounce control training; small-sided court play.

cases.title: Soccer Training Ball, Size 5
cases.visual_evidence: Grass/turf field; outdoor durability cues; water-resistant usage; team practice and full-size field context.
cases.text_only_failure: surface text is close to the indoor futsal item, but context indicates outdoor match training.
cases.descriptor: outdoor field soccer practice; team drills; grass/turf match training.
